M-HORIZONTAL-SLIDER-WIDGET.Purpose: Native one-axis controlled scalar slider reporting enabled user proposals within its supplied bounds.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: HorizontalSlider Value, MinValue, MaxValue, OnValueChange, Disabled and Tooltip.
Scope.SCP-IN-002: Native Widgets.HorizontalSlider drawing and default/explicit Flexbox measurement.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Two-axis drag semantics — owned by M-AREA-SLIDER-WIDGET.

Requirements.REQ-001: Widgets.HorizontalSlider receives externally owned Value and min/max bounds; it returns a proposed value within native control behavior.
Requirements.REQ-002: OnValueChange is raised only for enabled proposals differing from Value.Value by more than Mathf.Approximately; the slider does not assign Value itself.
Requirements.REQ-003: Disabled temporarily turns off native GUI interaction and absorbs clicks while restoring previous GUI.enabled and GUI.color after drawing.
Requirements.REQ-004: MeasureFunc uses preferred intrinsic width at least 80 and height 14, respecting width/height measure modes and explicit point dimensions.

Inputs.IN-001: Value: float, MinValue, MaxValue and OnValueChange callback.

SideEffects.EFF-001: Native slider drawing and callback invocation for changed enabled input.
